name: Night Light, Transparent Note Board Erasable Writing Message Board Home Desktop Small Whiteboard Table Lamp
description:
Product Name: LED Night Light Lamp

Product Dimensions: Height: 7 cm × Length: 13 cm
Weight: 180 g

Style: Table Light Lamp
Color: USB Monochrome Light Base
Material: Acrylic
Shade Material & Color: Clear Acrylic

Included Components: Power Cable
Special Features: Perfect as a friendship gift
Switch Installation Type: Tabletop
Type of Bulb: LED
Wattage: 4 W

Description:
Illuminate your space with this elegant LED Night Light Lamp. Made from durable acrylic with a clear shade, it creates a soothing ambient glow, ideal for bedrooms, offices, or as a decorative accent. Its compact tabletop design and USB-powered functionality make it both practical and stylish. A thoughtful gift for friends or loved ones, this night lamp combines simplicity, elegance, and functionality in one unique piece.
